pages.text: Blend $(item)2 or 3$() compatible single-variety loose tobaccos in the crafting grid. Inputs must share the same cut, fermented state, and ruined state. Blended Tobacco itself is not a base blend input.

pages.title: Distinct Components
pages.text: A blend component is identified by $(thing)variety + cure + aromatic flavor$(). Quality-only differences of otherwise identical tobacco are for averaging/homogenizing, not blending. The same variety may appear more than once only when its cure or aromatic flavor differs.

pages.title: Result
pages.text: The output count equals the number of inputs. Quality and aged days are averaged. If cure types differ, the result records a Mixed cure. Component snapshots are stored so the blend’s identity survives later processing.

pages.title: Secret Blends
pages.text: Servers can define hidden named blends that match variety, minimum quality, cure, and flavor requirements. The default configuration includes several examples; the resulting item name and tooltip use the intrinsic blend name once a definition matches.
